nodes.label: ADR-014 Document identity includes attachment manifest
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision: document identity and private storage path include proposal, chapter, format, payload snapshot hash and attachment manifest hash.
nodes.rationale: An unchanged payload with different attachments must create a distinct record and binary rather than corrupt audit metadata or overwrite historical results.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Payload and manifest dual-hash document identity
nodes.summary: Unique identity includes proposal/chapter/format/snapshot_hash/manifest_hash; both hashes appear in deterministic private path; changed manifest creates new record.
nodes.rationale: Attachment-only changes cannot overwrite old binary or corrupt immutable audit metadata.

nodes.label: Generated artifact immutability and reuse
nodes.summary: Identical hash pair reuses record; generated path cannot change; existing generated bytes not rewritten; stale download fails closed and old artifacts follow retention policy.
nodes.rationale: Idempotence preserves history and avoids duplicate or overwritten exports.

edges.evidence: Both require version/context identity to distinguish reproducible reuse from stale cached results, across documents and analysis.
